card_title: Artist Notes: Precision Define Lip Liner
summary: Architectural lip boundaries. A gel-based, waterproof liner that reshapes and secures the perimeter of the lips.
description: Lock in your color DNA. This intensely pigmented pencil glides with zero drag, setting down into a transfer-proof barrier that prevents the migration or feathering of glosses and lipsticks.
technical_overview: Offered at $19.0 for 1.2g, this KoColor LIP_LINER is expertly formulated with Synthetic Wax, Isododecane, and Iron Oxides. It delivers a high-fidelity Terracotta Core color profile (`#CC4E46`) and leverages cross-linked hydrophobic barriers.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Trace the outer edge of the lip line to define, then shade inward to create an adhesive base.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Overline exclusively at the cupid's bow and the center of the bottom lip, keeping the corners strictly to your natural line to avoid a distorted aesthetic.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: High wax content combined with volatile silicones creates an immediate, immovable seal.
